tasks.label: db: migrate
tasks.detail: Start Postgres and apply the migrations (make migrate)

tasks.label: web: dev
tasks.detail: Vite dev server on :5173, proxying /api to :8000 (make web)

tasks.label: api: ready
tasks.detail: Wait up to 60 s until the API on :8000 answers /api/health/ready
tasks.command: timeout 60 sh -c 'until curl -sf http://localhost:8000/api/health/ready >/dev/null; do sleep 0.5; done' || { echo 'The API on :8000 is not ready: start "API (debug)" or make api.'; exit 1; }

tasks.label: web: dev, api ready
tasks.detail: The Vite dev server is up and the API answers
